name: base-001-taklons-roundincome-double-brainstone
description: NOT FIXED - base-game (non-Lost-Fleet) engine anomaly, out of this session's LF-focused triage scope. During Phase.RoundIncome, live incremental play (fromData-clone-and-replay-the-accumulating-partial-line, the exact technique both real hosts use) required Taklons to resolve an ambiguous Brainstone placement TWICE in a row (both offered commands were the single choice {area2,area3}), producing the committed line 'taklons brainstone area2. brainstone area2'. A fresh sequential replay of the exact same seed+moves (new Engine(moves)) only accepts ONE of the two brainstone decisions and throws 'Unnecessary commands at the end of the turn: brainstone area2' on the second - i.e. live play and replay disagree on how many Brainstone interrupts RoundIncome requires for this exact state. No Lost Fleet content is involved (Taklons is a base faction, Brainstone/RoundIncome is base-game machinery); RULES_CLARIFICATIONS.md has no entry covering base Taklons behavior, so there is no CONFIRMED rules basis to change engine code, and the owner's explicit instruction for this session was to treat the base-game implementation as trusted/working and focus effort on Lost Fleet rules. Recorded here as a reproducer for a future base-game-focused session; NOT added to fuzz/regressions/ (which asserts green) since fixing it is out of scope.
